test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Based on the alphabetical order, three of the following four are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e866fb782fb27697540c09e531348bb0b91b712d7084656a2f4281c6c2000f58.png] 

**Logic:** First letter - 2 = Second letter; Second letter + 4 = Third letter

 
• RPT → R - 2 = P; P + 4 = T
 
• YWA → Y - 2 = W; W + 4 = A
 
• FDH → F - 2 = D; D + 4 = H
 
• EJN →** E + 5 = J; J + 4 = N**

Hence, '**EJN**' is the correct answer.
